name: init
description: Establish and converge on a shared repository overview before task-specific planning.

steps.action: First inspect active same-workspace peer sessions through the active harness transport; prioritize discovery and dispatch to existing dedicated Reviewer, Builder, or Scout peer sessions rather than spawning nested subagents; then continue to repository scale assessment or anchor capture, resolve active Tier 2 VCS capability, and determine if Scout reconnaissance is required, or proceed to direct survey.
Perform read-only topological reconnaissance and return a structured scout-survey message artifact to Planner.

Validate survey evidence or survey repository ground truth; inquire and confirm out-of-tree shadow scaffolding vault binding; upon explicit operator authorization, invoke initialization scaffolding (with vault scaffolding when confirmed) when living memory is absent (requiring explicit force authorization if replacing existing files) to scaffold baseline living memory and record vault binding in comprehensive AGENTS.md.
Review the current AGENTS.md artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Reviewer feedback into the AGENTS.md artifact.
Review the updated AGENTS.md artifact and report missing, ambiguous, or incorrect context.
Incorporate Builder feedback into the AGENTS.md artifact.
Evaluate whether the current inquiry pass reached consensus.
Finalize and persist the AGENTS.md artifact at repository root.

name: plan
description: Apply one substantive internal technical plan review including affected interaction contracts and public Given/When/Then TDD cases before routing work to Builder; optional consultation precedes formal planning.

steps.action: Assess feature requirements and choose between optional pre-planning consultation (CONSULTATION_REQUESTED) or direct plan drafting (DIRECT_PLANNING); for multi-component work within single task plan, an optional architectural Blueprint view may be included. The 17-step legacy Blueprint flow remains an explicit opt-in compatibility path.
Provide optional technical and architectural consultation advice upon Planner inquiry before formal plan drafting; consultation advice is not plan approval and never authorizes Builder work.

Author coherent task build-plan (including public Given/When/Then TDD scenarios published before implementation, authorized module/behavior boundary, explicit exclusions, and affected interaction contracts with reuse evidence) and private review-plan in the resolved plan vault (~/.agentplaybook/<project>/plan/); ordinary shared-contract changes identify affected consumers to invalidate only affected prior plan approvals and require integration acceptance.
Submit task build-plan and review-plan to Reviewer for one substantive internal technical plan review.

Review build-plan and review-plan for intent, scope, decomposition, affected interaction contracts, Given/When/Then TDD scenarios, independent verification paths, and E2E classification; evaluate plan structure and evidence without mandating ceremonial split challenges. PLAN_REVIEW_PASS provides internal technical approval and is the sole approval required for Builder dispatch.
Revise task build-plan and review-plan based on Reviewer feedback, decomposition rationale, and verification requirements.
Finalize plan artifacts after PLAN_REVIEW_PASS, record coverage and affected revision identities for ordinary shared-contract changes, and route single-plan work to build flow via blind handover.

name: blueprint
description: Execute hierarchical feature development with independent Blueprint concept and shared Interaction Contract gates, JIT sub-plan gates, and unchanged downstream code/E2E composition gates.

steps.action: Author or update blueprint-plan (<slug>.blueprint.md) in the resolved plan vault, defining high-level goals, shared Interaction Contracts, invariant boundaries, feature-level E2E scope/composition obligations, and ordered sub-plan sequence.
Execute Blueprint concept Gate on blueprint-plan, validating architectural coherence, shared-boundary scope, and sub-plan boundary definitions; shared contract approval remains a separate gate.

After BLUEPRINT_PASS, independently review blueprint-level shared Interaction Contracts or the concrete no-interaction rationale; SHARED_CONTRACT_REVIEW_PASS is separate from concept and JIT sub-plan approval.

Revise rejected blueprint-level shared Interaction Contracts or blueprint concept; every shared-contract amendment invalidates prior approvals for dependent sub-plans and returns through the Blueprint concept Gate and then this separate shared-contract review before JIT reassessment.

Resume JIT at the earliest affected or next ordered sub-plan; author or refresh its plan pair with mandatory E2E Verification/Coverage and pending contract sections. Reassess every dependent sub-plan through Sub-Plan and contract gates; prior approvals invalidated by a shared-contract amendment are not reusable.

Execute Sub-Plan Gate on current sub-plan pair, evaluating concept, scope, verification coverage, boundaries, and Track B definitions; SUBPLAN_PLAN_PASS is necessary but not sufficient for Builder dispatch.

After SUBPLAN_PLAN_PASS, identify scenario-driven interaction boundaries, record ordered reuse evidence, and finalize typed Interaction Contracts for this JIT sub-plan; document concrete not-applicable rationale when no interactions exist.
Independently review the current sub-plan Interaction Contracts or not-applicable rationale; contract approval remains separate from implementation/code review.

Revise rejected sub-plan Interaction Contracts; contract-only changes return to contract review, sub-plan concept/scope changes return to Sub-Plan Gate, and shared-contract amendments return through Blueprint Gate plus the separate shared-contract review, invalidate all dependent sub-plan approvals, and resume JIT reassessment at the earliest affected unit.

Implement approved sub-build-plan only after BLUEPRINT_PASS, SHARED_CONTRACT_REVIEW_PASS, SUBPLAN_PLAN_PASS, and CONTRACT_REVIEW_PASS, strictly within declared boundaries and finalized Interaction Contracts; execute local tests and report verified diff and logs to Planner.

When Track B is selected, assert the pinned baseline identity tuple (repository_identity, baseline_identity) before evaluating differential measurements and emit BASELINE_STALE on drift; independently inspect code diff against sub-review-plan and report structured findings to Planner.

Mediate and sanitize review findings into actionable remediation instructions for Builder, strictly withholding review-plan artifacts; shared-contract amendments invalidate all dependent sub-plan approvals and return through Blueprint Gate and separate shared-contract review before earliest-affected JIT reassessment; route local contract changes through JIT gates before another Builder handoff.
Synthesize sanitized sub-review-resolution artifact (sub/<slug>.resolution.md) in the plan vault recording resolved findings, waivers, deviations, and verified evidence.
Verify sub-review-resolution artifact against sub-review-plan and determine sub-plan completion status.
Synthesize master composition review-resolution artifact (<slug>.resolution.md) in the plan vault summarizing global outcomes and cross-plan evidence.

Execute Feature Composition Gate across all completed sub-plans, shared contracts, regression suites, and required admitted E2E evidence (or reviewed not-required rationale), emitting FEATURE_REVIEW_PASS only when required E2E evidence is admitted.
Trigger Governed Milestone Acceptance and advance to the commit flow.

name: build
description: Execute blind handover after internal PLAN_REVIEW_PASS, implement changes autonomously within authorized module/behavior boundary, and verify locally.

steps.action: After internal technical PLAN_REVIEW_PASS, dispatch the finalized approved build-plan to Builder via blind handover; strictly withhold review-plan artifacts and private criteria. Direct build entry without approval is prohibited.

Autonomously implement minimal required changes within the authorized module/behavior boundary plus explicit exclusions using public Given/When/Then scenarios; execute TDD RED (distinguishing intended assertion failures from setup errors), GREEN, and refactor; non-behavioral tasks supply static/specification evidence; escalate any protected shared or public contract modification or new requirement to Planner.

Arbitrate escalation from Builder: for minor boundary clarifications, resolve inquiry and authorize Builder resumption (ESCALATION_RESOLVED -> 2); upon encountering protected shared or public contract changes, boundary expansions, or new requirements, stop affected work and return to amended plan review before Builder resumes (PLAN_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED -> 4).
Stop affected implementation work upon new requirement or protected contract change, and return to the plan flow for amended plan review before Builder resumes.

Verify implemented changes against acceptance criteria using local automated tests or static/specification evidence, and hand off the verified working copy diff and test execution logs to Planner without committing.
Inspect working copy diff against in-scope boundaries, verify local test execution, and hand off to Reviewer without committing.

name: review
description: Independently inspect code diff, evaluate severity and evidence modes (Track A/B or static), execute reproduction and fix loop, and synthesize review resolution.

steps.action: Forward verified diff from build flow to Reviewer for code review, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact in the plan vault.

When Track B is selected, assert the pinned baseline identity tuple (repository_identity, baseline_identity) before evaluating differential measurements and emit BASELINE_STALE on drift; inspect code diff against the review-plan artifact for scope compliance, correctness, test adequacy, independent counterexamples, Track B differentials, and classify findings into formal severities (Blocker, Major, Minor, Other) with concrete evidence vs preference; unresolved Blocker blocks REVIEW_PASS; resolved or arbitrated Blocker and resolved or waived Major may pass; Minor and Other do not block; Delta-review material changes rather than restarting unchanged checks; no advance secret fixture is required; approval represents internal technical approval and not an independent external assessment.
Mediate and sanitize review-findings to Builder with severity and evidence mode, strictly withholding the review-plan artifact.

Establish a Track A failing reproduction test for behavioral findings (application code Out-of-Scope during this phase) or compile static/specification evidence for non-behavioral findings, then hand off to Planner for baseline verification before proceeding to fix.

Fix application code until all tests pass (or verified static evidence is produced); frozen test dependency surface must not be modified. Builder may begin Green work only after Planner has recorded the baseline reference and frozen dependency surface under Track A verification; Builder must not report FIX_VERIFIED until Planner has audited the frozen paths. Report resolved diff and test logs to Planner for frozen-path audit and VCS governance.

Planner classifies approved plan: if E2E is required (E2E_REQUIRED), freeze candidate revision and route to e2e flow (paused or unexecuted E2E blocks final REVIEW_PASS and required E2E is never relabeled as not required); if E2E is not required (E2E_NOT_REQUIRED with documented rationale) or admitted E2E evidence is verified, synthesize sanitized review-resolution artifact in the plan vault recording coverage and affected revision identities, confirm REVIEW_PASS, and advance to the commit flow.
Arbitrate escalation with Reviewer (arbitrate Blocker, record waiver with rationale for Major, clarify/waive false positive, or evaluate scope change/plan update for unexpected error).
End the current review cycle and return to the plan flow to revise the task plans.

name: commit
description: Stabilize candidate identity, enforce Finalization Equivalence, update living operational memory, perform security scans, and seal revisions under VCS governance upon human authorization.

steps.action: Confirm internal technical review approval (REVIEW_PASS or FEATURE_REVIEW_PASS with verified E2E_EVIDENCE_ADMITTED when E2E is required) before seeking user authorization for local seal, and establish candidate baseline.
Await explicit user commit request to initiate persistence.
Query operational caveats from Builder and Reviewer (Reviewer must only report public, independently observable operational facts or 'no publishable caveats').
Update AGENTS.md with synthesized, sanitized caveats and fresh Observed-At provenance metadata.
Conduct narrow visibility and blind-barrier check on AGENTS.md to ensure no review secrets leaked.

Stabilize candidate snapshot identity, verify Finalization Equivalence (tree(Final) == tree(Verified)), and execute fail-closed secret scan via active security gate mechanism (non-zero exit code halts pipeline).
Present finalized candidate diff and Conventional Commit message, awaiting explicit human milestone acceptance authorization.

Verify unchanged candidate identity and seal milestone revision locally as ACCEPTED under Planner VCS governance via active VCS mechanism capability; user-requested external review of fixed candidate (or noting repository is not externally assessed) may occur after local seal and never substitutes for publication authorization.
Publish sealed revision to remote repository under explicit publication authorization via active VCS mechanism capability.

name: session-handoff
description: Formally capture anchor state, conduct multi-round readiness audit, enforce scoping boundaries, and execute validated session takeover.

steps.action: First inspect active same-workspace peer sessions through the active harness transport; prioritize discovery and dispatch to existing dedicated Reviewer, Builder, or Scout peer sessions rather than spawning nested subagents; then continue to repository scale assessment or anchor capture: capture all State & Topology Anchor fields and handoff evidence.
Revalidate anchor against live repository ground truth through the active VCS mechanism and scoped inspection.

Complete Readiness Audit Round 1 across all four mandatory dimensions: Plan Understanding, Progress & State Understanding, Architectural & Governance Decisions, and Permissions & Path-Scoping Invariants.

Complete Readiness Audit Round 2 across all four mandatory dimensions (Plan Understanding, Progress & State Understanding, Architectural & Governance Decisions, and Permissions & Path-Scoping Invariants); challenge unresolved assumptions.

Complete Readiness Audit Round 3 across all four mandatory dimensions (Plan Understanding, Progress & State Understanding, Architectural & Governance Decisions, and Permissions & Path-Scoping Invariants); record questions and evidence.
Enforce exact authorized tool roots, peer-session discovery/dispatch policy, blind barrier, and takeover permissions.
Evaluate independent PLAN_REVIEW_PASS, declared boundaries, falsifiable contracts, VCS-neutral wording, authorization separation, and release cadence.
Emit compact validated takeover state with anchor, audit evidence, risks, and next pickup.

name: cartography
description: Orchestrate structured visual diagram generation with Taste Gate evaluation, conditional advisory pushback, and zero context pollution.

steps.action: Formulate self-contained diagram-brief specifying WHAT to draw (all entities, relationships, labels, groupings) without requiring codebase exploration.
Dispatch diagram-brief message artifact to Cartographer.
Evaluate visual type, complexity budget (≤12 nodes), and brief semantic completeness under Taste Gate criteria.
Dispatch structured diagram-clarification-request message to Planner and await resolution; Planner's amended diagram-brief provides the explicit source of CLARIFICATION_RESOLVED.
Calculate layout geometry, determine HOW to render (4px grid, orthogonal elbow routing), generate self-contained HTML/SVG, and delegate visual validation to the active diagramming capability.
Persist diagram to docs/diagrams/<safe-name>.html (or record advisory proposal) and emit lightweight diagram-completion message to commissioner.

name: navigator-cartography
description: Orchestrate structured visual diagram generation commissioned by Navigator with Taste Gate evaluation, conditional advisory pushback, and zero context pollution.

steps.action: Formulate self-contained diagram-brief specifying WHAT to draw (all entities, relationships, labels, groupings) without requiring codebase exploration.
Dispatch diagram-brief message artifact to Cartographer.
Evaluate visual type, complexity budget (≤12 nodes), and brief semantic completeness under Taste Gate criteria.
Dispatch structured diagram-clarification-request message to Navigator and await resolution; Navigator's amended diagram-brief provides the explicit source of CLARIFICATION_RESOLVED.
Calculate layout geometry, determine HOW to render (4px grid, orthogonal elbow routing), generate self-contained HTML/SVG, and delegate visual validation to the active diagramming capability.
Persist diagram to docs/diagrams/<safe-name>.html (or record advisory proposal) and emit lightweight diagram-completion message to commissioner (Navigator).

name: e2e
description: Execute end-to-end verification against protected candidate source with run-scoped outputs, independent bounded cleanup, and complete structured report delivered to Planner.

steps.action: Admit only an approved plan and IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW_PASS, freeze immutable candidate revision identity, and issue complete e2e-brief execution contract (including Secrets Policy and credential authorization) to Verifier.

Perform read-only preflight in strict sequence: validate brief and credential policy/authorization; a policy-less or ambiguous brief halts with CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED where no provisioning or container start occurs; check credential allowlist and environment readiness; a provider denial after valid human authorization emits a non-admissible ENV_BLOCKED report to Planner without provisioning credentials or starting services; then verify candidate and material identity.

Execute fresh formal test execution with run-scoped output and resource names; partial startup, test failure, timeout, or cancellation still proceeds through independent bounded stop/cleanup and one complete structured report. If the runner is lost, controller emits a complete non-accepting terminal report from the run ledger.

Handle clarification or runner-loss events, validate report structure and correlation (including secrets_attestation presence with mode matching brief authorization, failing closed as E2E_INVALID_EVIDENCE on mismatch or credential leaks), and arbitrate evidence admission, environment-only retry with fresh run ID on unchanged candidate after confirmed cleanup, candidate remediation, or non-accepting halt.
Incorporate verified, admitted E2E evidence with confirmed cleanup and valid secrets_attestation into Review Resolution or milestone record, and advance to ordinary final review.
Remediate product or test changes under ordinary approved build plan boundary, running local development tests as needed.
Independently inspect candidate remediation diffs and tests; emit IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW_PASS only when fixes are verified to advance to a fresh E2E run on newly frozen candidate.

Terminate E2E verification without acceptance upon unresolvable defect, fatal error, cancellation, or unconfirmed cleanup; record non-acceptance disposition and halt pipeline without admitting candidate to final review or commit flow.
